d.)Contingent upon implementation of the measures to minimize harm as reflected in he Section 4(f) material the Department of the Interior would have no objection to approval of the Section 4(f) aspects of the project by the Secretary of Transportation.
a.) Noise
Since this project involves the widening of an existing highway in an area of extensive development, a noise exposure survey should be undertaken to determine if the closer proximity of traffic lanes and increase number of vehicles will have a detrimental effect on any existing land use. Procedures should be in accordance with PPM 90-2.
b.) Air Pollution
The region is classified Priority I
with respect to all major pollutants
It is thus important that no significant decline in air quality results\nin the immediate area of the project\neither during or after construction.
